note: Meitou only: town criers (Criers.cs). Now and then the helper picks a local of the town's own faction near your squad and fires EV_I_SEE_PLAYER_NICE_BUILDING on them (an event nothing else uses). Real news wins (the crier copies of rumours, outlaw news, war news and title talk, built in content.py, score 10); with no news to tell, the faction's own proclamation below about half the time (score 0, chance 50), so a quiet town stays mostly quiet.

say: Okran's light on all who keep his law!
Hear, faithful! The Phoenix watches. Sin is seen.
Report the skeletons and the heathen to the Paladins.
Pray, work, obey. So Okran wills it.
The Inquisition walks among you. The pure have nothing to fear.
By the Emperor's grace, the roads are safe for honest folk.
Hear, citizens! Taxes are due, and the samurai collect.
Trade is the Empire's lifeblood. Buy, sell, and keep your purse close.
Bounties posted! The nobles pay well for outlaw heads.
Mind your betters. A noble's word is law here.
Strength and honour! The Kingdom stands!
Hear, warriors! A Shek who runs from battle shames us all.
Fight well, die well. There is nothing else.
The Queen keeps the peace now. Not every warrior likes it.
Hear this! Books and old tech bought, fair prices for what the ruins give up.
The ruins are open to those brave enough.
Bring back what the old world left. The Hunters pay in cats.
Hear! No chains in this town. Not now, not ever.
Every slave freed is one more blade against the Empire.
Bring us the shackled and we'll strike the irons off.
News for the swamp! Mind your step and your purse.
The gangs keep the peace here. Pay them and you'll keep yours.
Blood spiders in the reeds again. Keep to the walkways.
Bar's open. Water's extra.
Anyone selling meat, see the barman.
Keep your blades sheathed inside the walls.
Bandits on the roads again. Travel in groups.
Looking for work? Ask around the bar.
Beds upstairs, paid up front. No refunds for the dead.
Whatever you're carrying, there's a buyer here. Don't ask who.
Fight in the street and you'll pay for the street.
Holy Nation patrol came through yesterday. Keep your head down and your idols hidden.
Shek come through looking for a scrap. Don't give them one.
Bar's open. Don't drink the water, drink the beer.
Fair prices, no questions.
Caravan leaving at dawn if anyone wants to walk with it.
Buying hides and copper. Good rates.
Keep the peace in here and nobody gets hurt.
